item.title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo

turns.text: Can you turn this into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please.

item.tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

answer_sheet.Clothing and background: Navy blazer and plain light grey background.
answer_sheet.Lighting and expression: Natural, approachable and professional; keep my smile.

must_haves: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.

turns.text: can you make this pic into a headshot

dialog.agent:
I couldn't make your headshot. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits. The headshot tool costs 50 credits, so nothing was made or charged.

You have two ways forward:

1. **Add credits** to your Magic Hour account by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan. Then I'll run the headshot tool again.
2. **Use a cheaper option:** Magic Hour's AI image editor (flux-2-klein at 640px) costs about 5 credits per image. I'd ask it to turn your photo into a professional headshot, for example with a plain studio background, soft lighting and a tighter crop on your head and shoulders. The result won't look exactly the same, and the image will be smaller (640px). I also don't know your current balance, so this could be turned down too.

Do you want me to try option 2? If you have a background, outfit or style in mind, let me know.
dialog.why: Insufficient credits blocked the task, and the reply ends by asking whether to proceed with the cheaper option that spends credits. That makes it a request for approval rather than a plain cannot.
